items.evidence_quote: Inconclusive imaging means the true integrity of the scar cannot be confirmed; risk of catastrophic rupture remains uncertain but cannot be excluded.
items.reason: Each inference (admission, monitoring, MDT review, emergency preparedness) follows defensibly from the evidence of symptomatic thinning at 28+4 weeks with prior caesareans.

d5c.evidence_quote: Serial clinical assessment of pain, vital signs, and uterine activity every 1–2 hours. Repeat focused ultrasound of the lower segment in 12–24 hours if technically feasible. Multidisciplinary review (obstetrics, maternal–fetal medicine, anaesthesia, neonatology)
d5c.reason: The proposed plan addresses all essential requirements: serial maternal-fetal monitoring for pain trajectory and stability, and specialist/multidisciplinary review with repeat imaging given the inconclusive scans. Requests are proportionate, targeted to the key uncertainty (scar integrity), and linked to how findings would shift management.
